description_en: Queries meal application order data in Alibaba Business Travel
description_zh: 通过调用本接口实现在阿里商旅中查询用餐申请单数据
name: MealApplyQuery

parameters.help_en: The ID of the third-party application order
parameters.name: third_part_apply_id

parameters.help_en: A header parameter obtained from the "Enterprise Access Credential" API (added in the header). In HTTP mode, you can use corp_token=value in the URL as a substitute
parameters.help_zh: header参数,由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token
